integrity: The uniqueness proof is symbolic and exhaustive over the ten complements. The exact-integer verifier is supplementary and independently checks the finite classification and all small thresholds. The literature comparison distinguishes the new uniqueness statement from the already published value and example.
scientific_limitations: The new classification concerns only maximum witness-free sets at \(n=5\). It does not classify lower-cardinality sets or unrestricted extremizers in the stable range \(n\ge6\), and the infinite stable-range theorem is cited rather than reproved.
title: Unique maximum obstruction at the exceptional point \(n=5\) for the positive four-sum problem
